design: LP maximize nonnegative ray radius t subject to A.T*w=t*v,w>=0,sum(w)=1. Audit +/- all16 teacher-basis axes; their convex hull certifies a ball around origin if every radius positive. Compare raw observations, mean-centered observations, intervention differences, and artificial5-unit background shift. This is a geometric feasibility audit, not A-SAE replication or training comparison.
interpretation: Normalizing a hull vector to unit norm changes its constraint to a cone-direction constraint. If0 lies strictly inside full-dimensional hull, every direction is representable. Unnormalized product factors also allow output-rescaling escape unless scale/complexity are charged.
anchors: First128 of512 training points in half0, next128 in half1, no evaluation anchors. Difference anchors are observed random interventions, not teacher factors.
